'''Halbard''' was a notable shipping magistrate in the [[Mid-Core]]<ref name="AJ7" /> and [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]]<ref name="TCSWE" /> regions during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. He was a native of [[Chandrila/Legends|Chandrila]].
